fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M73T31 (the persistent index keeps an entry's newer-format problem after the binary learns that format). No owner was present. The planner placed it under intent m4-runs-hold-up (runs finish without hand repair), as the sibling format-bump fix 01M732D2 was, and raised one question to the arbiter: full rebuild vs re-decoding only newer-format files, and whether pruning orphan index databases is in scope. The arbiter ruled (Decision index-rebuilds-on-entry-format-change): store the decoded entry.FormatVersion and rebuild on any difference; pruning orphan dbs belongs to a separate change set. One leaf planned under fast-reads; pruning left as a separate draft change set.
fields.title: Plan of the stale newer-format index fix (autonomous)
